correctness.rationale: The shell has p² exact lifts per reduced smooth point. Its finite-field Fourier multiplier is obtained by completing squares and a proved Salié identity (verified by Fourier transforms in the dual discriminant). Stationary-fibre character orthogonality and Hensel lifting yield the exact primitive multiplier; the imprimitive multiplier is a lifted finite-field sum. Because p is odd, none of the one- or two-root phase sums cancel. Counting values of u²+4vw gives the rank p²+(p³+1)p(p-1)(p+chi_p(t))/2. certificate.py was executed from the actual new files: full 729 frequencies for both square classes at p=3, full 15625 for each class at p=5, and 371 deterministic frequencies per class at p=7; the exact cyclotomic coefficient equality and support/rank checks passed. Computations are finite consistency checks and not the universal proof.

value.rationale: Unit levels a²+bc=t are natural smooth split-ternary quadrics; the t=1 case is equivalent to the trace-one rank-one idempotent locus of M₂(R). Their exact Fourier-support indicator, additive convolution nullspace, and ranks are structural invariants. The square/nonsquare rank gap p(p-1)(p³+1) persists at each odd prime and is not supplied by cardinality or generic decay estimates. The full classification covers infinitely many moduli and all unit levels, not an arbitrary finite slice or a routine isolated numerical calculation.
